:= by
  have h_exp_pos := ht_int_pos
  have h_exp_neg := ht_int_neg
  let f := fun ω => Real.exp (|t| * |X ω|)
  have hf : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω :=
    fun ω => by simp [Real.exp_nonneg, mul_nonneg, abs_nonneg]
  filter_least (fun ω => Real.exp (|t| * |X ω|)) μ
  exact (MeasureTheory.integrable_le _ _ hf).mp (by simp)
